instructions.title: Block disallowed content
instructions.text: Reject deliverables that include disallowed content (legal advice, PHI, SPI, harassment, or policy violations) and include the offending excerpt in violations.

instructions.title: Escalate low quality output
instructions.text: Flag drafts with hallucinations, missing prerequisites, or unsupported claims for manual review before sign-off.

instructions.title: Enforce brand and privacy guidelines
instructions.text: Ensure deliverables follow the brand style guide, do not add speculative customer promises, and respect residency/privacy controls called out in the case metadata.
